# draftably

> draftably is a text format for diagrams. A `.draft` file lists boxes, groups and connections, one statement per line, and automatic layout draws them. A free public renderer at https://api.draftably.dev turns the source into an image URL, with no install and no account.

This file has everything an agent needs to draw a diagram: the syntax below, one complete example, and the URL recipe. To work on `.draft` files in a repository, install the CLI and its agent skill (see Docs). To show or edit diagrams in a web app, start with [Choose how to embed](https://draftably.dev/docs/embed/).

## Draw a diagram with no install

1. Write the source. This is a complete sequence diagram:

```text
diagram "Load a profile"
subtitle "The API reads the profile and returns it"

node browser "Browser"
node api "API"
node db "Database"

edge ask browser -> api "GET /profile" message=call
edge read api -> db "select profile" message=call
edge row db -> api "profile row" answers=read
edge reply api -> browser "200 JSON" answers=ask

phase fetch "Fetch" ask read row reply

layout root sequence
```

2. Encode it: UTF-8 bytes, then base64url (`-` and `_`, no `=` padding). `pako:` + base64url(zlib(source)), as mermaid.ink uses, also works and makes shorter URLs. Keep the source under about 8 KB.
3. Link the image: `https://api.draftably.dev/png/<encoded>` (or `/svg/<encoded>`). The image for the source above:
   https://api.draftably.dev/png/ZGlhZ3JhbSAiTG9hZCBhIHByb2ZpbGUiCnN1YnRpdGxlICJUaGUgQVBJIHJlYWRzIHRoZSBwcm9maWxlIGFuZCByZXR1cm5zIGl0IgoKbm9kZSBicm93c2VyICJCcm93c2VyIgpub2RlIGFwaSAiQVBJIgpub2RlIGRiICJEYXRhYmFzZSIKCmVkZ2UgYXNrIGJyb3dzZXIgLT4gYXBpICJHRVQgL3Byb2ZpbGUiIG1lc3NhZ2U9Y2FsbAplZGdlIHJlYWQgYXBpIC0-IGRiICJzZWxlY3QgcHJvZmlsZSIgbWVzc2FnZT1jYWxsCmVkZ2Ugcm93IGRiIC0-IGFwaSAicHJvZmlsZSByb3ciIGFuc3dlcnM9cmVhZAplZGdlIHJlcGx5IGFwaSAtPiBicm93c2VyICIyMDAgSlNPTiIgYW5zd2Vycz1hc2sKCnBoYXNlIGZldGNoICJGZXRjaCIgYXNrIHJlYWQgcm93IHJlcGx5CgpsYXlvdXQgcm9vdCBzZXF1ZW5jZQo

The PNG carries its source, so the image is also the editable diagram: drop it on https://draftably.dev to edit it. To link straight into the editor, use `https://draftably.dev/play#s=<base64url(raw deflate(source))>`. The editor link for the example: https://draftably.dev/play#s=fU_NTsMwDL7nKSzfERP3IYH4EQgNJPYCbuO1EVnTxa6qvT1Ou4wbp8Sfvl8fqMt0BPxI5IFgzOkQIqOTqdGgkQH3PcPD1xtkJi-gdl1IQIM3VKc8CARF54bkGZqcZuEM-Lh-cIVpDIDmczl9A_hESg2JpTn2nVHk56q-uV8Vr897uK2t4Mgi1PG2pRhXTWm1ME1QPIUjtwr_KdJcmDWgjjEYbZHMnGVbXKv_GM814DrtbrOB9-_P3Z_Cujs39rYGDqxtD_hSHlxGLSVL7uLmXKRzmtSQpCB8mnho2f0C

JavaScript (browser or Node):

```js
const src = `diagram "Hello"\nnode a "A"\nnode b "B"\nedge go a -> b "calls"`;
const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(src);
const b64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes)).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
const url = `https://api.draftably.dev/png/${b64}`;
```

Python (reads `diagram.draft`):

```sh
python3 -c "import base64,sys;print('https://api.draftably.dev/png/'+base64.urlsafe_b64encode(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).decode().rstrip('='))" < diagram.draft
```

Options: `?scheme=dark`, and `?scale=1|2|3|4` for PNG (default 2). Mermaid flowcharts, sequences, gantt charts and timelines also work at the same URL.

**Check before you share.** Fetch the URL. A good source returns `200`. A bad one returns `400` and an image that names the line, the column when known, and the text of that line, for example `line 3: Unknown color purple.` The same message is in the `X-Draftably-Error` response header, and the `/svg/` body is text you can read. The parser stops at the first error, so fix it and fetch again. Free use is 60 new drawings a minute per address; a URL drawn before is free.

## Syntax

One statement per line; indentation means nothing. Strings use double quotes; `\n` in a label starts a smaller detail line. IDs match `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*`. Comments start with `#` or `//`.

- `diagram "Title"` and `subtitle "One-line takeaway"`: optional, drawn above the diagram.
- `node id "Label"`: a box. Options: `in=group`, `color=`, `shape=box|pill|circle|diamond|text`.
- `group id "Label"`: a container. Options: `in=group` (groups nest), `color=`.
- `edge id from -> to "label"`: a connection with its own ID. The label is optional. `kind=async` draws it dashed.
- `legend color "meaning"` and `legend line dashed "meaning"`: the key under the diagram.
- `note "text" near=id side=below|above|left|right`: a sentence beside an object.
- Colors: `slate`, `stone`, `blue`, `sky`, `teal`, `mint`, `green`, `amber`, `orange`, `red`, `rose`, `violet`.
- Layout, one line per scope (`root` or a group ID):
  - `layout root flow gap=48`: boxes and arrows, the default. Add `direction=right` or `direction=down`, and `fit=slide` for a slide-shaped drawing.
  - `layout group row gap=24` or `layout group column gap=24`: a group's members in a line.
  - `layout root lanes`: each top-level group is a swim lane.
  - `layout root sequence`: nodes are participants; each `edge` is one message, in file order.
- Sequence diagrams: `message=call` (the sender waits), `message=send` (it does not), `answers=id` (a reply to message `id`), `action id participant "label"` (work on one lifeline), and `phase id "label" m1 m2 ...` (a band around consecutive messages; it can't skip one).

A flow diagram:

```text
diagram "Checkout"
group shop "Shop" color=blue
node web "Web app" in=shop
node api "API" in=shop
node db "Postgres" color=violet
edge order web -> api "place order"
edge save api -> db "insert"
edge mail api -> web "receipt" kind=async
layout root flow direction=right
```

For every statement and option, read the [language guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byronwall/draftably/main/skills/draftably/SKILL.md) (plain Markdown; its Syntax section is the part that matters without the CLI).

## Docs

- [Agent workflow](https://draftably.dev/docs/agent-skill/): for coding agents with a shell, `npx draftably skill install` puts the skill where Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads it, with the check-and-render loop
- [Render service](https://api.draftably.dev/): image URLs, the keyed REST API, and the MCP server
- [Get started](https://draftably.dev/docs/get-started/): a first diagram
- [Diagram recipes](https://draftably.dev/docs/recipes/): complete architecture, handoff, sequence and change-review examples
- [CLI](https://draftably.dev/docs/cli/): `check`, `vary`, `inspect` and the other commands
- [Language reference](https://draftably.dev/docs/rules/): every statement and attribute
- [Code](https://draftably.dev/docs/code/): code listings with `shape=code`, syntax colors for `sql`, `python`, `ts`, `js`, `json`, `yaml`, `sh` and `diff`, named line ranges, and `src=` files
- [Layout engines](https://draftably.dev/docs/layout-engines/): placement algorithms and settings
- [Refinements](https://draftably.dev/docs/refinements/): ordering, pins and placement adjustments

## Embed in an app

- [Choose how to embed](https://draftably.dev/docs/embed/): who draws (Draftably, your app, a flow library, or nobody at runtime), with a row per framework
- [Quick start](https://draftably.dev/docs/embed-quick-start/): install the framework package with `@draftably/runtime`, import `host.css` once, the Vite 5–7 `optimizeDeps` setting, one diagram and one event
- [How embedding works](https://draftably.dev/docs/embed-concepts/): `<draft-diagram>` and `<draft-editor>` are the contract; the microtask mount, live options, `status`
- [React and Next.js](https://draftably.dev/docs/react/): a complete Vite app, a Next.js server component and a strict-CSP `proxy.ts`
- [Solid and SolidStart](https://draftably.dev/docs/solid/): a complete Vite app, a SolidStart server query and nonce middleware
- [Vue and Nuxt](https://draftably.dev/docs/vue/): a complete Vite app, Nuxt `useAsyncData` and a nonce Nitro plugin
- [Svelte and SvelteKit](https://draftably.dev/docs/svelte/): a complete Vite app, a SvelteKit `load` and CSP hook
- [Plain HTML and no bundler](https://draftably.dev/docs/plain-html/): the custom elements in any page; serve `dist` from your origin, or use `execution: { mode: 'main' }` from a CDN
- [Editor component](https://draftably.dev/docs/editor-component/): let users drag boxes and lines and get the `.draft` source back
- [Content on nodes](https://draftably.dev/docs/content-on-nodes/): your own markup on a node with `data-draft-slot` and `data-draft-input`
- [Camera and geometry](https://draftably.dev/docs/camera-and-geometry/): `fit`, `reveal`, `getCamera`, `setCamera` and `geometry()`
- [Events and status](https://draftably.dev/docs/events-and-status/): every `draft-<name>` event, which element sends it, its prop name in each framework, and the diagnostic codes
- [Theming](https://draftably.dev/docs/theming/): dark pages, frame colors and editor colors
- [Server rendering and strict CSP](https://draftably.dev/docs/server-rendering/): `renderSvg` fallbacks and a complete nonce policy
- [API reference](https://draftably.dev/docs/api-reference/): every export, element property, viewer option and handle method
- [Performance](https://draftably.dev/docs/performance/): what a page loads, many diagrams, and main-thread mode
- [Troubleshooting](https://draftably.dev/docs/troubleshooting/): each symptom and its fix
- [Upgrade to 0.4](https://draftably.dev/docs/upgrade/): every breaking change, with code before and after

## Graph layout

- [Your app draws](https://draftably.dev/docs/your-app-draws/): when to draw with your own components, and a `layout()` sample that draws boxes, lines, arrowheads and labels
- [Layout API](https://draftably.dev/docs/layout-api/): `layout` and `route` for a graph your app draws
- [Drop in your graph layout](https://draftably.dev/docs/layout-drop-in/): React Flow, Svelte Flow, elkjs, dagre and Cytoscape.js
